notes: Gen Z slang. Young, chronically online characters (Dialyn, Nangong, Belle and Sunna) now talk like it in casual moments, in texts and out loud: rizz, larp, wife dat, no cap, fr, lowkey, it's giving, the ick, delulu, touch grass and more. A word or two at a time, each in their own way: Nangong uses it to tease, Dialyn saves it for off-duty snark, Belle is pure Inter-Knot meme brain, and Sunna is quiet about it and never flirty (she's 17). It fades when they're serious or working. Fufu isn't one of them.
